column1: # flow_ref 1 source=tests/spec/flow_semantics/hoist_par_values.onsa tests=20 evaluated=20 unavailable=0 skipped=0 waiting=0
@ a part of block that reads the index is one value for each replica: 6 * f0 * x
render hoist_par_values.block_reads_i sr=0x41000000 params f0=0x3f000000 in x=[0x3f800000 0x40000000]
@ process again with another f0: the part is made again by each block
init 0 hoist_par_values.block_reads_i sr=0x41000000
process 0 params f0=0x3f000000 frames=1 in x=[0x3f800000]
process 0 params f0=0x40000000 frames=1 in x=[0x3f800000]
process 0 params f0=0x00000000 frames=1 in x=[0x3f800000]
@ a part of block that does not read the index: 3 * x + 3 with f0 = 0.5
render hoist_par_values.block_ignores_i sr=0x41000000 params f0=0x3f000000 in x=[0x3f800000 0x40000000]
@ a part of init that reads the index: 3 * k * x
render hoist_par_values.init_reads_i sr=0x41000000 cfg k=0x40000000 in x=[0x3f800000 0x40000000]
@ a part of init is kept by reset and a part of block is made again
init 0 hoist_par_values.init_in_block sr=0x41000000 cfg k=0x40000000
process 0 params g=0x3f000000 frames=1 in x=[0x3f800000]
reset 0
process 0 params g=0x3f800000 frames=1 in x=[0x3f800000]
@ a part of block that holds a part of init: 6 * g * k * x
render hoist_par_values.init_in_block sr=0x41000000 cfg k=0x40800000 params g=0x3e800000 in x=[0x3f800000 0x40400000]
@ a part that reads a let of block outside the par~: g = 2 * f0
render hoist_par_values.reads_a_let_of_block sr=0x41000000 params f0=0x3f000000 in x=[0x3f800000 0x40000000]
@ the argument of an instance in the body is a part of block of each replica
render hoist_par_values.instance_argument sr=0x41000000 params f0=0x3f000000 in x=[0x3f800000 0x40000000]
@ the argument of an instance in the body, with the block changing between calls
init 0 hoist_par_values.instance_argument sr=0x41000000
process 0 params f0=0x3f800000 frames=1 in x=[0x40000000]
process 0 params f0=0x3e800000 frames=1 in x=[0x40000000]
@ a delay in the body holds the product of the frame before, in each replica
render hoist_par_values.with_a_delay sr=0x41000000 params f0=0x3f000000 in x=[0x3f800000 0x40000000 0x40800000]
@ reset sets the delays back and the part of block is made again by the next block
init 0 hoist_par_values.with_a_delay sr=0x41000000
process 0 params f0=0x3f000000 frames=2 in x=[0x3f800000 0x40000000]
reset 0
process 0 params f0=0x3f800000 frames=2 in x=[0x3f800000 0x40000000]
@ a par~ in a par~: the part of the inner body is made for each pair, 8 * f0 * x
render hoist_par_values.nested sr=0x41000000 params f0=0x3e800000 in x=[0x3f800000 0x40000000]
@ the range of ..= : 9 * f0 * x
render hoist_par_values.closed_range sr=0x41000000 params f0=0x3f000000 in x=[0x3f800000 0x40000000]
@ a condition of block that holds guards the part of block of each replica
render hoist_par_values.block_guard sr=0x41000000 params n=4 in x=[0x3f800000 0x40000000]
@ a condition of block that does not hold takes the else branch in each replica and makes nothing
render hoist_par_values.block_guard sr=0x41000000 params n=0 in x=[0x3f800000 0x40000000]
@ a condition of init and a part of block under it
render hoist_par_values.init_guard sr=0x41000000 cfg a=1 params d=5 in x=[0x3f800000]
render hoist_par_values.init_guard sr=0x41000000 cfg a=0 params d=0 in x=[0x3f800000]
@ a condition of sample in the body is decided by the frame
render hoist_par_values.sample_guard sr=0x41000000 params n=4 in x=[0x3f800000 0xbf800000]
@ the frame that does not take the branch does not make the part (n = 0)
render hoist_par_values.sample_guard sr=0x41000000 params n=0 in x=[0xbf800000 0x00000000]
@ a par~ that has parts of init only: 0 + 1 + 4 + 9 + 16 = 30
render hoist_par_values.slow_only sr=0x41000000 in x=[0x3f800000 0x40000000]
@ the whole par~ is a part of block: 3 * f0 * x, made again by each block
init 0 hoist_par_values.whole_par_of_block sr=0x41000000
process 0 params f0=0x3f000000 frames=1 in x=[0x40000000]
process 0 params f0=0x40000000 frames=1 in x=[0x40000000]
